violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

finding_variants.text: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.
It was determined that a caregiver grabbed a child by his arm and neck while forcefully getting him off the floor.

Based on the information found during the investigation, there was sufficient evidence to support that a caregiver grabbed and pulled on a child?s arm when attempting to redirect the child as a form of guidance.
The operation was out of compliance when a caregiver pulled and dragged a child into the classroom from the hallway.

Based on the information obtained during the investigation and through multiple interviews, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation of inappropriate and prohibited disciplinary practices
Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation it was determined a caregiver used prohibited punishment by grabbing a child.
